description: Visibility statistics per site, observer height and period; see docs/SOURCES.md
sun_rule: sunlit_pct, longest_night_*: any part of the solar disc above the terrain horizon (docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md, A12); mean_sun_fraction_pct: mean visible share of the disc
earth_any_part_rule: earth_any_part_pct: any part of the Earth's disc above the terrain horizon (definition of the LOLA Earth-visibility map), independent of the link rule
sun_and_earth_rule: sun_and_earth_pct: any part of the Sun visible and the Earth link rule met at once
